665:t_001:48.en:
$$ラム$$
「Captain. The Galactic Raid Fleet, including the new $$バスターマシン$$ No. 3, has reportedly begun moving toward the central point as well.」

665:t_001:49.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「Most likely the $$真ゲッタードラゴン$$, and the $$ＥＬＳ#keyword$$ and fleet that went to support them, are also heading for the galactic center point.」

665:t_001:50.en:
$$キャシー$$
「That's where the enemy we must defeat... the nest of the $$宇宙怪獣$$ is...」

665:t_001:51.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「Gravity quake detected. Someone is about to appear in this sector.」

665:t_002:1.en:
$$バスターマシン７号$$
「$$宇宙怪獣$$!」

665:t_002:3.en:
$$レド$$
「It looks like we've already entered their sphere of influence!」

665:t_003:0.en:
$$アルト$$
「Looks like they mean to stop us from heading for the nest!」

665:t_003:1.en:
$$オズマ$$
「To draw attention away for $$バスターマシン$$ No. 3, let's make a flashy mess of them!」

665:t_003:2.en:
$$ランド$$
「Understood! An order like that is more than welcome!」

665:t_003:3.en:
$$アポロ$$
「Heh...! It's like the first round of the decisive battle! Let's finish this quick!」

665:t_003:4.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「All units, begin the attack! To protect the $$フロンティア船団$$ behind us, too, we'll finish this fast!」

665:t_004:0.en:
$$モニカ$$
「Group of units approaching this area confirmed!」

665:t_005:0.en:
$$ブレラ$$
「Those $$バジュラ$$! The ones controlled by the $$ギャラクシー船団$$!」

665:t_006:1.en:
$$クラン$$
「After the battle in the $$霧の海$$, it seemed to have joined up with the $$ギャラクシー船団$$'s forces, but...」

665:t_006:2.en:
$$ミシェル$$
「Look at that number...! Don't tell me the $$ギャラクシー船団$$ has teamed up with the $$人類銀河同盟$$!?」

665:t_006:3.en:
$$ルカ$$
「Chamber! I'll send you the data we gathered on our side, so please analyze it!」

665:t_006:4.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「Analysis complete. That $$マシンキャリバー$$ differs in the details from those of the $$人類銀河同盟$$.」

665:t_006:5.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「That unit is presumed to be a replica mass-produced on the basis of $$ストライカー・Ｘ３７５２#robot$$.」

665:t_006:7.en:
$$ストライカー#pilot$$
「We are the Human Support and Enlightenment Regulation System...」

665:t_006:9.en:
$$ストライカー#pilot$$
「We are a system that exists to enlighten humanity toward a better existence...」

665:t_006:10.en:
$$アルト$$
「That's the same thing the Striker we fought in the $$霧の海$$ said!」

665:t_006:11.en:
$$ルカ$$
「Most likely, just like the units, that interface has been duplicated and installed in every one of them.」

665:t_006:12.en:
$$オズマ$$
「Every single one of those has an AI that calls itself a god aboard!?」

665:t_006:13.en:
$$クラン$$
「Why would something like that cooperate with the $$ギャラクシー船団$$...!?」

665:t_006:14.en:
$$ブレラ$$
「The two share an extremely similar way of thinking.」

665:t_006:15.en:
$$オズマ$$
「What do you mean, $$ブレラ$$!?」

665:t_006:16.en:
$$ブレラ$$
「The $$人類銀河同盟$$ treats humans as parts that make up society, and pursues rationality and efficiency.」

665:t_006:17.en:
$$ブレラ$$
「That is the same concept as the $$ギャラクシー船団$$, which used $$インプラント$$ technology to rationalize and streamline social structure and humanity.」

665:t_006:18.en:
$$レド$$
「So $$ストライカー・Ｘ３７５２#pilot$$ is cooperating with them to realize its own ideal!」

665:t_006:19.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「And the $$ギャラクシー船団$$, having gained the power of the $$バジュラ$$, aims to...」

665:t_006:20.en:
$$ブレラ$$
「Most likely to rule the entire galaxy with that power.」

665:t_006:21.en:
$$レド$$
「So the society that results from that is $$ストライカー・Ｘ３７５２#pilot$$'s ideal world!」

665:t_006:22.en:
$$シン$$
「The whole universe could be in trouble, and they do whatever they please!」

665:t_006:23.en:
$$モニカ$$
「Does that mean the $$ギャラクシー船団$$ is also operating here in the galactic core...」

665:t_006:24.en:
$$ボビー$$
「Even so, attacking us right after we warped in is too convenient, isn't it!?」

665:t_006:27.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「They're ignoring the $$宇宙怪獣$$ and coming at us. For now, all we can do is intercept.」

665:t_006:28.en:
$$ノノ$$
「We've come all the way to the $$宇宙怪獣$$' nest, and humans are fighting each other...!」

665:t_006:29.en:
$$バスターマシン７号$$
「We've come all the way to the $$宇宙怪獣$$' nest, and humans are fighting each other...!」

665:t_006:30.en:
$$ダイバスター$$
「We've come all the way to the $$宇宙怪獣$$' nest, and humans are fighting each other...!」

665:t_006:31.en:
$$カズミ$$
「Focus, $$ノノ$$. If we stop here now, it means the end of the Earth!」

665:t_006:35.en:
$$アルト$$
「Damn! Are they saying they don't care if the universe is destroyed!」

665:t_007:0.en:
$$モニカ$$
「Annihilation of the $$宇宙怪獣$$ and the $$ギャラクシー船団$$ forces confirmed.」

665:t_007:1.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「Never mind the $$宇宙怪獣$$, but I never thought the $$ギャラクシー船団$$ would strike here...」

665:t_008:1.en:
$$スズネ$$
「If $$バアル$$ is left alone, the very existence of this universe is in danger, so why...」

665:t_008:2.en:
$$オズマ$$
「We foiled their ambitions once in the $$再世戦争$$... Maybe it's revenge for that.」

665:t_008:3.en:
$$アルト$$
「Leaving the universe in danger over that, just to attack us...」

665:t_008:4.en:
$$アムロ$$
「Even in a situation like this, they can't let go of a personal grudge.」

665:t_008:5.en:
$$シャア$$
「If you call that human, it's all too human.」

665:t_008:6.en:
$$ブレラ$$
「Through implants, they have power beyond comparison with ordinary humans...」

665:t_008:7.en:
$$ブレラ$$
「On top of that, they've gained the power of the $$バジュラ$$ and even the technology of the $$人類銀河同盟$$.」

665:t_008:8.en:
$$ブレラ$$
「And yet they haven't shed the ego that wants to dominate others and stand at the top.」

665:t_008:10.en:
$$タケル$$
「But it isn't only the $$ギャラクシー船団$$. $$ミケーネ$$, Emperor $$ズール$$, and the $$宇宙魔王#pilot$$ are the same.」

665:t_008:11.en:
$$葵$$
「Even after gaining power beyond humans, what they're doing is still human... and no different from villains, huh...」

665:t_008:12.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「That's not a new stage of humanity... It's the ego of those who got power.」

665:t_008:13.en:
$$ガムリン$$
「In the end, no matter how far you go, humans are still humans...」

665:t_008:15.en:
$$ミレーヌ$$
「Hey, $$バサラ$$! Stop saying whatever and stirring things up!」

665:t_008:16.en:
$$バサラ$$
「What are you talking about. If the heart's gone, we can't even sing anymore, can we.」

665:t_008:19.en:
$$クロウ$$
「In short, a villain's a villain. Whether it's $$バアル$$, the system, or a self-proclaimed god.」
